title: Multiple Choice - Conversation Completion
description: Choose the correct response to complete the conversation.

questions.text:
Liam: "How can I avoid generating so much plastic trash when buying groceries?"
Emma: "______________________________"
options: You can purchase heavy chemical fertilisers for your yard.
You should carry reusable canvas bags and produce nets.
You must buy more disposable water bottles every morning.
You ought to toss plastic takeaway containers into rivers.
questions.correct_answer: You should carry reusable canvas bags and produce nets.

questions.text:
David: "Where should I toss this empty soda can and glass bottle?"
Sarah: "______________________________"
options: Throw them straight into the organic garden compost pile.
Leave them on the cafeteria table for cleaners to collect.
Drop them into the blue recycling bin beside the doorway.
Bury them under the flowerbed to help fertilise plants.
questions.correct_answer: Drop them into the blue recycling bin beside the doorway.

questions.text:
Tom: "Would you like to join our neighborhood canal clean up this Saturday?"
Chloe: "______________________________"
options: I'd love to join, because I really care about cleaner waterways.
That sounds terrible, as nobody should ever clean up public areas.
I'm afraid I cannot attend since I prefer throwing trash outdoors.
No way, because clearing plastic waste will definitely harm ducks.
questions.correct_answer: I'd love to join, because I really care about cleaner waterways.

questions.text:
Lucas: "I love your stainless steel water flask! Where did you get it?"
Mia: "______________________________"
options: Thanks, but I only keep it as decoration on my living room shelf.
Thanks, though disposable cups are definitely much better to use.
Thanks, but it produces too much harmful methane gas in kitchens.
Thanks, I carry this reusable bottle daily to reduce plastic waste.
questions.correct_answer: Thanks, I carry this reusable bottle daily to reduce plastic waste.

questions.text:
Alex: "Our dormitory electricity bill went up significantly this month!"
Rachel: "______________________________"
options: We can install old inefficient light bulbs to increase consumption.
We should keep all ceiling lamps running brightly during daytime.
We ought to open all windows while running the heater on high power.
We must remember to turn off air conditioners before heading out.
questions.correct_answer: We must remember to turn off air conditioners before heading out.

questions.text:
Daniel: "Do you think shopping at zero waste package-free stores is practical?"
Sophie: "______________________________"
options: No, since organic food scraps should always go into landfills.
Yes, because buying single-use plastic cutlery is cheaper for us.
Yes, bringing our own glass jars saves packaging in the long run.
No, because sorting garbage increases dangerous toxic pollutants.
questions.correct_answer: Yes, bringing our own glass jars saves packaging in the long run.

questions.text:
Noah: "Did you hear about the massive wildfire raging in the northern forest?"
Grace: "______________________________"
options: Yes, it released huge clouds of carbon dioxide and destroyed trees.
Yes, it safely broke down all household waste into organic soil.
No, burning woodlands is an effective way to conserve resources.
No, wildfires only produce clean drinking water for forest animals.
questions.correct_answer: Yes, it released huge clouds of carbon dioxide and destroyed trees.

questions.text:
Jessica: "What should we do with all these vegetable peelings and melon rinds?"
Ben: "______________________________"
options: Let's pour synthetic chemical fertilisers directly on the kitchen floor.
Let's flush all fruit peelings down the bathroom sensor tap immediately.
Let's toss them into the compost pile instead of the rubbish bin.
Let's seal them in non-biodegradable takeaway containers forever.
questions.correct_answer: Let's toss them into the compost pile instead of the rubbish bin.

questions.text:
Oliver: "Some people leave the restroom taps dripping water all day long."
Zoe: "______________________________"
options: Leaving water flowing constantly is a great way to save resources.
The building manager should install an automatic sensor tap here.
Students must always drink water directly from garden hoses outside.
We should encourage everyone to pour dirty wastewater onto desks.
questions.correct_answer: The building manager should install an automatic sensor tap here.

questions.text:
Sam: "Why are you riding your bicycle to school instead of asking for a ride?"
Lily: "______________________________"
options: Cycling burns fossil fuels rapidly, which creates heavy air pollution.
Cycling produces zero emissions, which shrinks my carbon footprint.
Pedaling to school is dangerous because it harms wild river birds.
Riding a bike requires a lot of single-use cardboard packaging boxes.
questions.correct_answer: Cycling produces zero emissions, which shrinks my carbon footprint.
